facts.fact: Media Rights Agenda reports the Freedom of Information Act is being implemented, with Section 29 requiring public institutions to report annually to the Attorney-General.

The Attorney-General's 2025 implementation report to the National Assembly, submitted 24 March 2026, gives requests received by institutions (for example NBC 40, CBN 29, NTA 17) from 108 reporting institutions, with 180 listed as defaulters.

NGA.note: The document states nothing about a digital feedback channel.
The document only lists the Nigeria Police Force as a non-reporting institution; no station record system is stated.
The document gives no rural electricity access figure.
